description: Search public research documents, initially SEC EDGAR filings. Use this to find 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, DEF 14A, Form 4, and 13F-HR documents before calling get_document. Use datasetId sec.full_text_search with query when searching across EDGAR text without a specific company.

asOf.description: Historical availability ceiling, preferably a timezone-aware ISO timestamp. Calendar-period selection alone is not publication-time or original-vintage replay. Release archives and SEC documents support disclosed historical approximations; some current-only sources cannot return historical evidence.

datasetId.description: Registered document dataset id from discovery, such as sec.filings, sec.filing_sections, sec.current_filings, or sec.full_text_search.

documentTypes.description: SEC form filters such as 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, DEF 14A, 13F-HR, 4.

entity.description: Ticker, CIK, company name, or manager name. Optional for SEC full-text search.

name: search_documents
title: Search public research documents
